recoil.title: Recoil: Master the Kickback and Own the Battlefield
recoil.slogan: Recoil ain't your average shooter. Get ready to blow stuff up!
recoil.description: Recoil takes you into a colorful game world with unique shooting gameplay. Master the kickback, shred through insane levels, and own the battlefield. The combination of skill and ingenuity can bring you closer to a glorious victory. Strict physics-based gameplay is also the biggest challenge you will face. Ready to conquer the peak? Play Recoil now!
